# McAfee
> McAfee provides consumer cybersecurity products including antivirus, identity monitoring, privacy, and online protection services.

McAfee’s website includes product information, support resources, account management, and security guidance for individuals and families using McAfee protection plans and tools.

## Products
- [Total Protection](https://www.mcafee.com/en-us/antivirus/mcafee-total-protection.html): Comprehensive antivirus, privacy, and identity protection for individuals and families.
- [McAfee+](https://www.mcafee.com/en-us/antivirus/mcafee-plus.html): Protection plan combining device security, privacy, and identity monitoring features.
- [Identity Protection](https://www.mcafee.com/en-us/identity-theft-protection.html): Identity monitoring and recovery-focused protection against fraud and theft.
- [Antivirus](https://www.mcafee.com/en-us/antivirus.html): Overview of McAfee antivirus products for malware and threat protection.
- [VPN](https://www.mcafee.com/en-us/vpn.html): Secure VPN product information for private browsing and safer public Wi‑Fi use.
- [Safe Browsing](https://www.mcafee.com/en-us/safe-browsing.html): Browser and web protection features for avoiding risky sites and scams.

## Support
- [Support Home](https://www.mcafee.com/support/): Main support portal for troubleshooting, downloads, and customer assistance.
- [Knowledge Center](https://www.mcafee.com/support/?articleId=TS100342&page=shell&shell=article-view): Searchable technical help articles and product troubleshooting resources.
- [Virtual Assistant](https://www.mcafee.com/support/contact): Automated support and contact options for McAfee customers.
- [Download and Install](https://www.mcafee.com/support/?articleId=TS102477&page=shell&shell=article-view): Instructions for downloading and installing McAfee software on devices.
- [Uninstall McAfee Products](https://www.mcafee.com/support/?articleId=TS101331&page=shell&shell=article-view): Steps for removing McAfee software from supported systems.
- [PC Optimization](https://www.mcafee.com/support/?articleId=TS102654&page=shell&shell=article-view): Help resources related to performance and optimization features.

## Account and Subscription
- [My Account](https://www.mcafee.com/consumer-support/my-account.html): Access account settings, subscriptions, billing, and device management.
- [Sign In](https://www.mcafee.com/consumer-support/my-account/sign-in.html): Customer login page for managing McAfee services and subscriptions.
- [Auto-Renewal Settings](https://www.mcafee.com/consumer-support/my-account.html): Manage subscription renewal preferences and billing details.
- [Redeem Retail Card](https://www.mcafee.com/activate): Activate a retail purchase or subscription code for McAfee products.
- [Subscription Help](https://www.mcafee.com/support/contact): Contact and support options for billing and subscription issues.

## Downloads and Installation
- [Free Antivirus Trial](https://www.mcafee.com/en-us/antivirus/free.html): Trial download page for evaluating McAfee antivirus protection.
- [McAfee Mobile Security](https://www.mcafee.com/en-us/antivirus/mobile.html): Mobile security product information and app-related protection features.
- [Windows Protection](https://www.mcafee.com/en-us/antivirus/windows.html): Security product information tailored for Windows devices.
- [Mac Protection](https://www.mcafee.com/en-us/antivirus/mac.html): Security product information and coverage for macOS devices.
- [Android Protection](https://www.mcafee.com/en-us/antivirus/android.html): Android-focused mobile protection and privacy feature overview.
- [iPhone Protection](https://www.mcafee.com/en-us/antivirus/ios.html): iOS and iPhone security, privacy, and identity-related protection overview.

## Security Learning Center
- [Security Center](https://www.mcafee.com/en-us/security-center.html): Educational hub covering online safety, threats, and cybersecurity best practices.
- [What Is Antivirus](https://www.mcafee.com/en-us/antivirus/what-is-antivirus.html): Introductory explanation of antivirus software and how it protects devices.
- [What Is a VPN](https://www.mcafee.com/en-us/vpn/what-is-a-vpn.html): Overview of VPN technology, benefits, and privacy use cases.
- [What Is Identity Theft](https://www.mcafee.com/en-us/identity-theft/what-is-identity-theft.html): Explains identity theft risks, warning signs, and prevention basics.
- [What Is Malware](https://www.mcafee.com/en-us/antivirus/malware.html): Overview of malware types, risks, and protection strategies.
- [How to Remove Viruses](https://www.mcafee.com/en-us/antivirus/how-to-remove-virus.html): General guidance on detecting and removing computer viruses.

## Blog
- [McAfee Blog](https://www.mcafee.com/blogs/): Main blog covering cybersecurity news, tips, and consumer safety topics.
- [Consumer Security Tips](https://www.mcafee.com/blogs/tips-tricks/): Practical advice for safer browsing, devices, and online accounts.
- [Privacy and Identity](https://www.mcafee.com/blogs/privacy-identity-protection/): Articles about privacy, identity monitoring, and fraud prevention.
- [Scams](https://www.mcafee.com/blogs/internet-security/scams/): Coverage of scam trends, warning signs, and avoidance strategies.
- [Mobile Security](https://www.mcafee.com/blogs/mobile-security/): Posts focused on smartphone threats, apps, and mobile privacy.
- [Online Safety for Families](https://www.mcafee.com/blogs/family-safety/): Guidance for protecting children and families online.

## Contact and Customer Service
- [Contact Support](https://www.mcafee.com/support/contact): Customer service entry point for support and account assistance.
- [Community](https://forums.mcafee.com/): User community forum for peer help and product discussions.
- [Refund Policy](https://www.mcafee.com/consumer-support/policy/returns.html): Information about returns, cancellations, and refund eligibility.
- [Warranty and Subscription Terms](https://www.mcafee.com/consumer-support/policy/auto-renewal-terms.html): Terms governing subscription renewal and related service conditions.

- [Cookie Notice](https://www.mcafee.com/consumer-support/policy/cookie-notice.html): Information about cookies and tracking technologies used on the site.
